Toca Boca World: Game & Play
Create & Roleplay Family Life
Free · In‑App Purchases · Designed for iPad

Boo! We’ve unlocked creepy decorations, hair, accessories & facial details, with 10 new gifts available at the Post Office.
Welcome to a world where your imagination comes first! Make up stories in the colourful locations, and customize your own buildings – you can style your own outfits too!
Toca Boca World is all about open-ended play. There are no rules, just colorful ways to be creative. Build your world, and fill it with characters, pets, shops and all kinds of houses!
Almost everything inside Toca Boca World is customizable, or you can jump straight in and play! Try running a café, become a hair stylist, camp in the forest or throw a rooftop party. It’s a safe universe where kids explore and discover at their own pace.
BUILD YOUR OWN WORLD
• Explore apartments, shops and hangouts in Bop City
• Design your own characters with unique hair, faces, outfits and accessories
• Decorate spaces with Home Designer. Change the walls, furniture and colors
• Add pets, food, toys and silly items so each place feels like your own
PLAY YOUR WAY
• Create your own stories. Become a chef, spa owner, rockstar, or teacher
• Mix and match locations to invent your own mini games and challenges
• Move characters between homes, schools, shops and secret spots
• Try roleplay like running a pet hospital, opening a fashion studio or hosting a sleepover
EXPLORE, DISCOVER AND COLLECT
• Find hidden gems, secret rooms and surprises in the locations
• Visit the Post Office every Friday for free gifts including furniture, outfits, decorations and pets
• Grow your world as new packs and locations are added to the in-app shop
MADE FOR KIDS, EASY TO PLAY
• Simple, touch-first controls make it usable for all reading abilities
• No time limits or high scores. Just creative play
• Open-ended design lets kids follow their own curiosity
SAFE, SINGLE-PLAYER AND AD-FREE
• Toca Boca World is a single-player kids' game, not chat and no strangers
• COPPA compliant, and carefully designed as a safe space for kids
• No third-party ads ever. Play is never interrupted by adverts or pop-ups
AWARD-WINNING FUN FROM TOCA BOCA
Our game has been recognized as App of the Year and an Editor’s Choice for its playful design and dedication to kids’ safety. Our award-winning kids game can be downloaded on phones, tablets and computers, with optional in-app purchases for families who want to expand their world. We believe in the power of play. That’s why Toca Boca World is built as a high-quality, ad-free game that lets children explore, create and imagine freely.
STAY CONNECTED
Discover new locations, events and collaborations by following Toca Boca World on social media and inside the in-app shop. There’s always a new story waiting.

Editors’ Choice
The long-awaited moment for Toca Boca fans has arrived. Toca Boca World, the newest edition to the popular series, brings together all the Toca Life apps, letting your beloved characters from different apps mingle in one beautiful world. And this unique world keeps growing: The app continually updates with new areas to explore and characters to meet.

The bug is getting worse
Are you looking to buy this? Read before you get it. Although I just did five stars so you could see and I would’ve done four instead, this is the best game ever! My sister and I play it for like five house every week! lol. The reason I would’ve done four is because of the bug, unfortunately it has been here for years but it keeps getting worse and worse. Now we are lucky if we can even get in. If your wondering what the bug is it just usually kicks us out of the game when we join or when we press on our houses or locations. I read the other reviews and did what the creators suggested. I tried shutting it down and back on again, I tried to update the game, and I tried playing it with all my other apps closed. None of these worked. I hope it gets fixed soon because we have spent SO much money on this game and are so lucky that our grandparents pay for it. I would hate for that to get wasted. We are waiting for it to get fixed and although I am a kid so I have no experience with fixing bugs or anything, I have been hoping they would fix it soon it has been taking a very long time and I really want for it to get fixed soon I don’t know if I can wait anymore. I really love your game and would hate to see anymore reviews about this bug. To wrap this all up this is an amazing game but the bug is messing it up. I hope nothing stops you guys from fixing it soon. From your biggest fan! A big thank you to my teacher who taught me how to write like this! lol

I can’t play the game
Hey! Let me just start off by saying I love this game, it lets me be really creative with all the little touches I can add to my homes and characters! But lately the app has just closed out whenever I tried to open it. I was wondering if this was just me or if it was happening to someone else. So because of this I was looking through reviews and saw some nice ideas for the game, one of them that I really liked was about adding earrings and other jewelry to the game, even if you have to buy a pack to get it I think that would be a fun touch. And it also included the little closet area where you can mix and make your own clothes getting more items. Also I’ve seen a lot of people asking for everything to be free, I personally don’t mind things costing money because there’s a bit of a thrill being finally able to afford something, and the developer has to make money somehow, but I was thinking once or twice a year you could a Black Friday kind of sale where everything is a bit less expensive so that everyone if they want to can have a chance to buy what they want without having to pay the full price. Also I’m really hoping the developer is reading this, the reviews that I looked at with developer responses, for the responses they were all the same thing mostly about “thank you for the rating” and “we value your ideas” but never actually connecting back onto the idea, almost a bit half-hearted. If you could please think about what I said the would be appreciated, thank you!
